articles.summary: Entegris addresses critical industry need through strategic acquisition, Taiwan manufacturing investment, and partnership with Element Six Entegris, Inc. (Nasdaq: ENTG), a leading supplier of critical advanced materials and process solutions for the semiconductor and other high-technology industries, today announced two important milestones in its strategic expansion into the market for silicon carbide (SiC) and diamond-enabled thermal management materials solutions for next-generation AI advanced packaging. “Growth in AI compute, from model training to inference, is intensifying power and heat-management demands in data centers,” said Olivier Blachier, President, Materials Solution and SVP, Chief Innovation Officer at Entegris. “We are excited to announce that Entegris is entering this fast-growing market to bring necessary innovation to meet our customers’ chip and package level materials demands.” First, Entegris has completed its acquisition of Advanced Abrasives Corporation, a
articles.title: Entegris Enters Silicon Carbide and Diamond-Enabled Thermal Management Materials Market for AI Advanced Packaging
